title: lysimachia japonica var. thunbergiana
intro: Lysimachia japonica var. thunbergiana, commonly known as Japanese golden grass or golden creeping Jenny, is a type of flowering plant belonging to the primrose family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and boosting the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Lysimachia japonica var. thunbergiana include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which can help to protect against cell damage and promote overall well-being. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
